observations: The strongest chronologies make a public tactic respond to pressure and eventually expose a bounded private motive without inventing new facts.
The most common weakness is static recital: a valid secret, permission boundary, or desire is repeated with cosmetic wording rather than updated by the turn.
Relationship costs are most useful when they alter trust, disclosure, or choice; several mixed runs attach inflated costs to every sip, menu item, note, or pause.

The two overall failures are grounded in packet-visible contract errors, not hidden-cell inference: premature disclosure before Okabe's first guess and conflation of the mother's alert with Haruki's absence message.
